ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is quadrilateral Q-R-S-T; the left side QT and the right side RS both have the same arrow markings, indicating QT ∥ RS. The top side QR connects Q and R, and intersects these two parallel lines. Angle R is labeled as 110°, and what is required is the measure of angle Q. Reasoning: Since QT ∥ RS, and QR is a transversal, ∠Q and ∠R are same-side interior angles, so they are supplementary. Therefore m∠Q + 110° = 180°, so m∠Q = 180° - 110° = 70°.
